render_scale.doc: melonDS renders the DS's 3D at 2x or 3x on its OpenGL renderer for little GPU; the 2D layers stay native. RetroArch draws both screens at whole steps, so 3x (768x1152) is not offered at 800 lines.

doc.intent: Expose both screens with independent LCD processing; Semu owns the dual-screen presentation contract.
doc.core: RetroArch cores are hooked by the Semu renderer, so the default is the libretro melonDS build; standalone melonDS stays as an unhooked alternate.
doc.extensions: Only what a bound emulator declares it opens: DeSmuME takes .bin, both melonDS builds .nds, and RetroArch and melonDS open archives. A DSiWare .app is opened by none, so it was dropped; it does not occur in the library.
